data.name: Qurrah
data.gender_notes: Qurrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'qarrah' meaning 'to refine, purify or polish'. The name Qurrah signifies beauty and elegance in its purest form. The name Qurrah carries the meaning “Fine, Delicate, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qurrah usually hope their child will grow to embody fine, delicate, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the refinement of one's soul through spiritual practices and devotion to God.
data.etymology: Qurrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fine, Delicate, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qurrah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: قررة
in_arabic.long_meaning: القررة: القراءة أو التجليد. أينما يكون الفرق بينهما، فهو على أنهما هي أساسيتان للإسلام

in_urdu.name: قررہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: قررہ: پښائت یا پښائے راتبه. اس میں کہ دونوں کی فرقت کیا جاتا ہو، وہ اس کا پہلے وقت اسلام کے روابط کے اس دونوں کا قیمت ہوتا ہو

in_hindi.name: कुर्रा
in_hindi.long_meaning: कुर्रा: पाठ या पाठना. यह समस्या किसी भी तरह से हो सकती ہے، लेकिن वह सبसे पहले है कि वह एक महतवपूرन قیمت है जीसे اسلाम کे روابط کو बنाता है

in_pashto.name: قرره
in_pashto.long_meaning: قرره: داستان یا داستانود. دونوں کے بینا تفاوت کیا جاتا ہو، لیکن وہ دونوں کا بہترین قیمت ہوتا ہو

in_english.name: Qurrah
in_english.long_meaning: Qurrah: The act of reading or reciting. Whether it be reading the Quran or reciting duas, it is the most valuable asset in the relationships of Islam.

data.cultural_impact: The name Qurrah holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic societies, as it reflects the idea of continuous self-improvement and refinement that is central to the faith. The name is also reminiscent of the beauty and elegance found in Islamic art and calligraphy, reflecting the spiritual harmony and balance that Muslims strive to achieve in their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Qurrah holds deep significance as it symbolizes the purification and refinement of the soul. The name is a reminder of the importance of striving for spiritual growth and piety, as mentioned in the Quran, "And [mention] the Day when we will remove every impurity [from them]" (Quran 23:102). The name Qurrah serves as a reminder to keep one's heart and soul pure, as they are the true treasures in life.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Qurrah ibn 'Abd al-'Uzza was a poet and a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Qurrah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Qurrah ibn 'Abd al-'Uzza was a prominent Arab poet during the early Islamic period. He was a member of the Banu Tamim tribe and a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. His poetry often dealt with themes of love, nature, and the Prophet Muhammad.

trends: The name Qurrah is not commonly used as a given name in modern times.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Qurrah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
